name: tiny-context
description: Know things about files without reading them. Eight local MCP tools — file_map, query_file, read_section, query_table, summarize_log, diff_files, validate_file, extract — that outline, search, slice, query, cluster, diff, validate and extract from files including PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, returning only what the agent needs with a token-savings line on every response. Ships a skill that tells Claude when to use them instead of whole-file reads.
